content: To understand the symptoms of pinworm infections and prevent reinfection, it is important to follow proper hygiene practices and adhere to medical advice. This medication should be taken orally, with or without food, typically as a single dose or as directed by your doctor. It can be consumed with milk or fruit juice. The dosage is determined based on your weight, the type of infection, and your response to treatment. Do not exceed a total of 1 gram in a single dose. If self-treating for pinworms, take the medication only once and do not repeat the dose without consulting your doctor. Depending on the type of worm infection, your doctor may recommend a single dose or a course of treatment over several days. Common side effects may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach or abdominal cramps, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, trouble sleeping, or loss of appetite. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. If you experience any unusual or severe symptoms, contact your doctor immediately. For medical advice about side effects, U.S. residents can call their doctor or the FDA, while Canadian residents should contact their doctor or Health Canada. Before taking pyrantel, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Rarely, this medication may cause drowsiness or dizziness. Limit alcoholic beverages. Chewable tablets may contain aspartame, so inform your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU) or any other condition requiring you to limit aspartame intake. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary, and it is unknown if it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. In case of overdose, if someone has serious symptoms such as passing out or trouble breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Some types of worm infections can spread easily among family members or people living in the same household. It is important for all household members to be checked, even if they do not show symptoms. To prevent reinfection, everyone in the household may need treatment. Additionally, thoroughly clean the home and all clothing, and maintain strict personal hygiene. Wash hands frequently and keep fingernails trimmed. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
